issues.what: The 'השוואה' button sits on the card's left edge with its text and icon cramped against the card, looking tight but not clipped; minor spacing only.

issues.where: the 'בעלים' card at the bottom, above the bottom navigation bar

issues.where: the grey note line under the tabs, second line

issues.where: the car card's header, top-left area
issues.what: The השוואה button sits beside the car name, but the car name's title lines are fine; no clipping seen. Not a defect on closer look, so this item is withdrawn.

issues.where: the car card's chevron at the top left of the card
issues.what: The chevron points left (›-like, pointing toward the left edge) next to the plate; in RTL a chevron that opens the car's details should point left, so this is acceptable. No defect reported.

issues.where: the plate input field at the top
issues.what: The typed plate number is drawn in dim yellow on the yellow plate background, so it is hard to read; this is a contrast issue, though the text is typed rather than a placeholder.

issues.where: the bottom of the scrolling content area, just above the keyboard
issues.what: The card 'חיפוש דגמים' is cut off by the keyboard edge; content continues below, which is acceptable scrolling, so this is not reported as a defect.

issues.where: the top of the car table card, between the card's top edge and the table header row
issues.what: The card starts with a blank band of empty space above the column headers (רכב, טסט, ריקול, טיפול אחרון), which looks like a missing element or an unused area rather than intended spacing.

issues.where: the card's description paragraph, third line
issues.what: The phrase reads 'טסט שמתקרב' (the upcoming test); the word looks spelled oddly in the rendering, possibly a letter misread. Low confidence.

issues.where: the bottom sheet's Android-visible area, the last row of the 'מחירי דלק וחשמל' card (the 'חשמל' price input)
issues.what: The third fuel price row (חשמל לקוט"ש) is cut off by the bottom edge of the sheet/screen above the navigation bar; its input box and label are partly hidden. This is content continuing below the visible part of the screen, which is scrolling, so it is not a defect by itself.

issues.where: the period chips under the 'בחירת תקופה' card
issues.what: The year chips wrap so that the 2022 chip sits alone on a second line, right-aligned, while the other four chips share the first row. It looks like an unbalanced layout rather than a deliberate arrangement.

issues.where: the settings sheet, the 'תצוגה' section's 'רקע' segmented control
issues.what: The segmented control's options 'בהיר', 'כהה' and 'לפי המכשיר' are crowded together with the selected 'בהיר' option tightly boxed; 'לפי המכשיר' nearly touches the control's left edge, so the row looks cramped at 200% font size.

issues.where: the settings sheet, the 'צריכת דלק' section
issues.what: The fuel consumption options stack vertically with the selected option in a white box, which reads as a bit uneven but is consistent; no clear clipping visible.

issues.where: the table header of the car card, first (leftmost) column
issues.what: The column header wraps onto two lines and reads as "טיפ" over "אחו", so the letters at the edge of the card look clipped and the header is hard to read as "טיפול אחרון".

issues.where: the table header of the car card, leftmost column header, at the left edge of the card
issues.what: The header is cut: it shows only "טיפ" over "אחו", while the full word should read "טיפול אחרון". Letters are missing at the end of both lines, so the column title cannot be read.

issues.where: top of the white table card, between the card's top edge and the divider line above the column headers
issues.what: A large empty band at the top of the card, with only a thin divider line and no title or content, looks like missing content.

issues.where: the second card, under the title line
issues.what: The word "תיק" sits alone on its own line below "יש לכם כבר רכב? פתחו לו", leaving an orphaned word that looks like a wrapping bug at 130% font size.

issues.where: the plate input field at the top, the yellow number plate
issues.what: The plate digits are a dim olive colour on the yellow field, which is hard to read. It may be a deliberate placeholder shade, but it looks like typed text.

issues.where: the first brand chip row, below the 'יצרנים נפוצים' heading, the third row of chips partly visible above the keyboard
issues.what: The brand grid is cut off by the on-screen keyboard's top edge; this is a scrolling list, so it is not a defect by itself and no item is hidden in a broken way beyond normal scrolling.

issues.where: the car card's header, the left arrow chevron next to the plate
issues.what: The chevron beside the plate points left, which in right-to-left means it points toward the content, not forward or back in the expected way; it is a detail control with no clear label, so it is ambiguous. Low confidence design issue.

issues.where: the large empty area between the car card and the bottom navigation bar
issues.what: Only one car card is shown, leaving a large empty area below it; this is expected for a single-car list and not clearly a defect.

issues.where: the cars table card, between the top edge of the card and the first divider line above the column headers
issues.what: The card has a blank band of roughly 60 dp above the divider line and the column headers, with no content in it. It looks like an empty header area where something should be, such as a title or a filter row.

issues.where: the example chip under the sentence 'רוצים לראות איך זה נראה?'
issues.what: The words in the example chip are in the wrong order for Hebrew. Read right to left the phrase should start with 'נסו לדוגמה' and then give the plate, but the screen shows the plate first, then 'נסו', then 'לדוגמה' from left to right.

issues.where: the plate input in the yellow field at the top
issues.what: The plate digits are drawn in a dim olive shade on the yellow field, so they look faded and are harder to read than the rest of the screen. It is unclear whether this is typed text or a placeholder.

issues.where: the period chips in the 'בחירת תקופה' card
issues.what: The 2022 year chip sits alone on its own second line, under 2026 (עד אוק׳), while 2023, 2024 and 2025 share the first row. It looks like a wrapped control dropped onto its own line rather than an intentional arrangement.

issues.where: the chevron at the far right of the 'שוק הרכב' header bar, next to the title
issues.what: The chevron beside the page title appears to point left, which is the 'forward' direction in right-to-left layouts. A back control at the right edge should point right. Confirm the arrow direction; it may be the wrong way for going back.

issues.where: bottom navigation bar, the bell icon for התראות
issues.what: A red notification badge sits on the bell icon and partly covers it; this is a normal badge, so not reported as a defect.

issues.where: the top bar, plate box in the centre
issues.what: The last digit of the plate appears to sit tight against the right edge of its yellow box, so it may be partly clipped at 200% font size. Hard to confirm at this resolution.

issues.where: the selected 'סקירה' tab at the right of the tab bar
issues.what: The word fills its blue tab almost edge to edge, with no visible padding on the right side, so it may be clipped at the edge of the tab.

issues.where: the sheet's header, the top-left close button area and the title row
issues.what: At 200% font size the header title and the settings bar sit tight; no obvious clipping visible, so this is not a defect.

issues.where: the background (dimmed) header behind the sheet, the subtitle line under לוחית

issues.where: the search input, placeholder text
